target.current_objective: The SOFEF03F HBM black-screen root cause is fixed and verified on 2026-11-11: brightness >1023 requires DCS 0x53=0xe0 before the brightness write and 0x53=0x20 when leaving HBM. The deployed 0009 equivalent passed ten 1024-brightness DPMS cycles, real touch, the physical power key, and an external-power-removed cold boot. The 0003/0005 first-frame reapply and the MDSS-reset cold-boot candidates are superseded, not the fix. The active hardware block remains standardized USB2 platform adaptation. Wi-Fi, CDC NCM and SSH remain mandatory regression gates. Keep Type-C role/host, USB3/DP and suspend wake in separate layers. The DTB-only usb2-typec-sink, usb2-typec-dual and rebuilt usb2-vbus-wake candidates are offline; the wake r5 DTB is not flashed. usb2-vbus-wake uses the Android-proven PM8150 GPIO10 extcon_usb1 hardware and standard linux,extcon-usb-gpio, deliberately without the invalid wakeup-source property; wakeup is enabled by the udev power/wakeup policy. The SPMI PMIC arbiter periph IRQ is routed through PDC pin 1 (GIC SPI 481) in sm8150.dtsi. It covers cable insertion/removal only; it does not preserve NCM across system suspend, and host-initiated resume still needs the separate U3 keep-connect layer. The device is unreachable for SSH as of 2026-11-11. Do not write NV, persist, calibration or userdata.
target.goal_update_2026_11_09: Wi-Fi, CDC NCM and SSH are no longer active backlog items. They remain mandatory regression gates, but hardware adaptation continues with the remaining standardizable blocks without waiting for another dedicated network pass.
target.goal_update_2026_11_10: The active hardware block is USB. Use the mainline PM8150B Type-C/TCPM, DWC3 role-switch and standard connector graph in separate layers. A DTB-only sink candidate is compatible with the deployed gadget-only kernel; a dual-role candidate additionally requires a new ARM64 Image with DWC3_DUAL_ROLE and xHCI. Do not treat NCM connectivity as host, VBUS-source, USB3/DP or wakeup acceptance.
target.goal_update_2026_11_11: Commit only the adaptations with a defensible scope: the verified HBM panel fix, the desktop power-key bridge removal, the USB layering cleanup, and the measured camera preview/high-resolution paths. Keep invalid or unverified attempts explicitly marked: the extcon wakeup-source property, the APSD private Kconfig hooks, the U0 active-link wake experiment, the first-frame-only panel reapply, the MDSS-reset cold-boot candidate, and the power-key bridge are not production fixes.

open_items: The PM8150L rear flash/V4L2 pair is deployed from Linux and passed the runtime gate before and after an ordinary reboot: boot 5b4dd487…, FAT c99c690e…, DTB b244b3f1…, 774 baseline modules (777 after Bluetooth), white:flash and V4L2 controls present, torch at 200000 uA, S5KGW1 RAW mean +130%, faults 0, CAMSS suspended and taint 0. External-power-removed cold boot, repeated cold boots and long thermal endurance remain unverified.

The final private-status removal Image f8d89621… and FAT 1f4bbb30… were written from Linux with the unchanged boot 5b4dd487… and flash/V4L2 DTB b244b3f1…, then passed two ordinary reboots and two full 777-module runtime gates. All three MAX98937/AW8697 status nodes are absent; standard ALSA playback/capture and AW8697 input/FF remain present; four-camera RAW, flash/V4L2, Bluetooth, NFC, thermal and network gates pass with taint 0. Cold boot remains unverified.

A suspend attempt on boot 2b17a67a… armed the PMIC RTC directly through sysfs and issued loginctl suspend. NCM/Wi-Fi did not return within 140 seconds and the phone remained absent from Windows USB and fastboot. This is not a suspend pass. The earlier accepted s2idle run used rtcwake; after physical wake, capture /tmp/samurai-suspend-test.log and suspend_stats before retrying with rtcwake under a recoverable setup.

The signed samurai-platform 5-r22 is installed with Alpine neard-openrc and neard 0.20 while retaining the mainline nxp-nci-i2c node. After an ordinary reboot, nfc0 is present, neard starts from the default runlevel, the org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties and org.neard.Adapter methods work, power and polling start/stop cleanly, and the 777-module runtime gate passes. No physical tag was available, so TagFound/read/write, eSE, cold boot and long NFC power remain unverified.

The signed samurai-bluetooth-host 0.1.0-r0 package is installed and passed an ordinary reboot: bnep, uhid and uinput auto-loaded through the standard boot path, /dev/uhid and /dev/uinput open, the BNEP socket family is registered, BlueZ exposes hci0, and the full 777-module runtime gate passed with taint 0. External PAN/HID peers, cold boot and suspend/resume with active peers remain unverified.

The camera-final boot and the r21 network checkpoint passed an ordinary reboot, a 24/24 bidirectional NCM matrix with 1798.828 seconds of heartbeat, 1810 Wi-Fi SSH samples over 1820.51 seconds, and the full runtime/CAMSS/RAW gate on boot d5cfa04f. The later flash-LED/V4L2 deployment repeated the ordinary-reboot network and RAW/runtime gate on boot 364abb2c. External-power-removed cold boot and repeated cold boots remain unverified.

The current success is on a direct motherboard USB port and the Windows UsbNcm host. A Linux host, longer idle, larger continuous transfers, OTG/role switching and the old Genesys hub port remain separate acceptance cases.

NCM qmult=20 is now applied by samurai-platform 5-r21 on a fresh configfs gadget. A diagnostic initramfs that has already created the old gadget requires a reboot before the kernel-side request queue can change; the script will not hot-unbind a working NCM link.

WCN3990 firmware still reports no valid permanent MAC and ath10k logs "invalid MAC address; choosing random" at probe. The board helper reads the same-handset DMS identity and applies a stable Wi-Fi address (Bluetooth address is a separate same-handset value) before association; the same address is present in earlier boot logs. This does not write a permanent MAC into hardware, and the DMS query remains a thin vendor-data dependency.

The UEFI standard boot candidate is offline built but not flashed; GRUB execution, file-based volume discovery, root mount and rollback are unverified. Persistent UEFI variables are still not implemented.

The clock RBCPR candidate is offline built and object-proof verified but not flashed; it must boot without clk_ignore_unused and expose CLK_IS_CRITICAL before the constraint can be removed. The no-clk_ignore_unused live-FDT kexec preflight left the handset unreachable and is not a safe unattended path.
A no-kexec /dev/mem GCC gate sweep fallback is prepared but not yet run on hardware.

The fastboot warm-reboot USB enumeration workaround (clean NCM unbind before RESTART2) is prepared; the direct-port path removed the current enumeration failure, so the workaround still needs repeated warm-reboot evidence before it can be called a formal fix.

NFC tag I/O and fingerprint authentication still need end-to-end hardware validation. The NFC controller is bound, but no tag was available; the fingerprint sensor still has no mainline functional node/authentication chain.

The libcamera simple pipeline enumerated all four cameras and captured one 640x480 RGB888 frame from each. The unattended scene was mostly dark, so this proves the standard userspace path but not image quality, AF/AWB/LSC, recording, concurrent streams or thermal behavior.

Audio capture through the active user's PulseAudio/ALSA mic path passed 61.979979 seconds (2,975,039 samples, RMS 15.053, 0% clipping, empty stderr); headset/buttons, audio quality, SSR and long PM remain open.
NFC tag I/O, high-voltage charging, deep sleep, manual power-key cold boot and long-duration power measurement remain open. Managed high-voltage charging stays a separate profile.
The camera test initramfs and private scene RAW files must not be published.
The same DTB was not booted across RAM/UFS SKU variants, and the camera userspace stack has not been qualified on a second host/display configuration.
